# Blackmagic DeckLink SDK (macOS headers)

The headers and the dispatch source of Blackmagic Design's Desktop Video SDK, for
the Mac output helper's DeckLink outputs. They declare the API; the code behind it
is the Desktop Video driver the user installs, which `DeckLinkAPIDispatch.cpp`
loads at run time from `/Library/Frameworks/DeckLinkAPI.framework`. Nothing of the
driver is in this repository.

| | |
|---|---|
| SDK version | 12.0 (`BLACKMAGIC_DECKLINK_API_VERSION` `0x0c000000`, `DeckLinkAPIVersion.h`) |
| Taken from | [obsproject/obs-studio](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio), `plugins/decklink/mac/decklink-sdk/`, at commit `7d98bebe1115b12608837b622164ea5fe6d9483a` (the SDK last updated there in `79dd0214a8`, "decklink: Update SDK to 12.0") |
| Files | `DeckLinkAPI.h` and the headers it includes, `DeckLinkAPIVersion.h`, `DeckLinkAPIDispatch.cpp`. The `_v*` compatibility headers are not needed and are not copied. |
| Changes | None. Each file is byte for byte as published. |

A driver newer than the SDK answers the 12.0 interfaces, so these headers work with
Desktop Video 12.0 and later. An older driver does not offer them, and the helper
reports it as too old rather than listing no ports.

## Updating

Replace the files from a newer SDK (Blackmagic's download, or the same OBS path),
keep their notices, and update the version and source above. The helper's own code
is in `Sources/DeckLinkShim/`, which is the only thing that includes these headers.
